messages.subject: Project Indigo - Licence (v3, our response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our response mark-up attached (tracked over your v2). We've moved to: exclusivity six years; minimum annual royalty £1.05m; general liability cap 125% of fees; IP indemnity cap £13.5m; and a small relaxation of the acceptance accuracy threshold to ±2.5%. Core-platform improvements remain with Caspian. We think this is a fair landing zone.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
